test_name: Joint elevator to Rumble in front of paint shop - 2266cd89-951f-42b8-9f72-045a7fb1e54f
summary: The ride to Rumble could not be tested, because the server does not know the new elevator until Joint's elevator list is reseeded, and that is a step for a person. I built the elevator from the paint shop elevator and put it on the flat floor next to the paint shop doors. It has one green button that sends players to the deathmatch group (Block or Shithole Rumble). In the editor the Joint lobby loads fine with it, and it shows up as a ride-out-only elevator.
instructions:
TASK: Add elevator to the Joint that takes you to Rumble - for playtest

DESCRIPTION:
We need to put an elevator in a central point in the Joint. It doesn't need to look good, just to work. Put an elevator that's accessible in front of the paint shop entrance, make it have only one button that takes you to deathmatch. Use paint shop as base for elevator.

For the playtest on Sunday 2026-10-11, 18:00 Israel time (card "Playtest!").

REQUEST (from Omer):
@Big Sys Please do this task: an elevator in front of the paint shop entrance in the Joint, with one button that takes you to deathmatch (Rumble). Use the paint shop as the base. It doesn't need to look good, just to work. We need it for the playtest tomorrow, Sunday 2026-10-11, 18:00 Israel time. Thanks!

EXTRA (from the card):
Needed for playtest on Sunday 2026-10-11, 18:00 Israel time (card "Playtest!").

JOB TYPE:
FEATURE REQUEST - asks to add a new elevator feature in the Joint that doesn't exist yet

GAME MODE:
MULTIPLAYER - the request says the elevator takes you to "deathmatch (Rumble)"
verified: Rumble Elevator instance exists in Joint, built from Paintshop Elevator Variant, next to the paint shop doors (edit-time captures)

Joint loads in Play mode on dev with the new elevator; mech spawns normally; mp/state lists Rumble_Elevator_be1c8351 out-only; no elevator errors
